shared_elements: upright stone monolith with rounded top
carved relief on a single vertical face
anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole panel
circular/disc-like element in the mid-body area
justification: Both are tall, rounded-topped monoliths bearing a single vertical relief panel with an anthropomorphic figure whose head/headdress fills the top, banded chest ornament in the middle, and a disc-like element at the mid-body, giving a broadly comparable top-to-bottom scheme. The rendering differs sharply, however: A is dense, fine, low-relief incision with crowded glyph-like blocks and small figural detail, while B is sparse, bold, deeply modelled relief on a massive blocky form, and the two are presented in completely different conditions (in-ground weathered stone versus lit museum display).
